email.body1:
Lindsey, saw Conduktor closed its $30M Series B and is building out the US team for expansion.

During a US push, the RevOps pain is usually signal-to-action latency: intent fires, but the team cannot act fast enough, and pipeline leaks before anyone notices. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach with zero rep time, lifting meetings 3-5x without new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Conduktor off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lindsey, quick follow-up for Conduktor.

Expanding into a new market, most RevOps teams lose pipeline on speed and consistency rather than data quality: signals sit, hand-offs slip, and the measurable lift never shows up. Built-in best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and 3 specific things I would change to shorten signal-to-action latency, every send auto-logged to your CRM.
email.body3:
Lindsey, last bit of proof for Conduktor.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Conduktor's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

If shortening signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know a US expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Conduktor either way.
